title: Importer good enough for Lindqvist
transcript:
[00:00] Clara: Lindqvist Dental wants to start moving their patient records next week. They're asking about the importer.
[00:07] Diego: The CSV importer works. It's rough around the edges, but it works.
[00:13] Yusuf: Rough how?
[00:17] Diego: Error messages are just row numbers, and it's slow on big files.
[00:23] Clara: They don't need it perfect. It needs to be good enough for the client to start using.
[00:31] Diego: Fair. Then I'll get it good enough for them by Tuesday.
[00:36] Yusuf: I'll write a short guide on the column format, with a template file.
[00:42] Clara: Great. I'll tell them Tuesday.
[00:46] Yusuf: Do they need the appointment history too, or just patients?
[00:51] Clara: Patients first. Appointments can come later.
[00:55] Diego: Good, that keeps it simpler.
[00:59] Clara: Thanks, all.
